title: 她警告：经济数据将让，市场普遍观点意外
speaker: Cathie Wood

segments.en: On this episode, rapid real growth is where we're going.
segments.zh: 本期节目，我们将探讨快速的实际增长方向。

segments.en: I love trying to put the pieces of the puzzle together, lessons learned in history.
segments.zh: 我喜欢尝试拼凑拼图，从历史中汲取教训。

segments.en: We have to go back to the industrial revolution to understand what's going on today.
segments.zh: 我们必须回溯到工业革命，才能理解今天发生的事情。

segments.en: Greetings, everyone. It is employment Friday, and it's Labor Day weekend here in the US.
segments.zh: 大家好，今天是就业数据发布日，也是美国劳动节周末。

segments.en: So happy Labor Day weekend to everyone.
segments.zh: 祝大家劳动节周末愉快。

segments.en: This month's In The Know will be a little different in that we're going to be talking about very long term charts.
segments.zh: 本月的《知无不言》将有所不同，我们将讨论非常长期的图表。

segments.en: And the reason for this is we're trying to make connections between, the industrial revolution and this technology revolution.
segments.zh: 原因是我们要在工业革命和这次技术革命之间建立联系。

segments.en: And this is a work in process for us.
segments.zh: 这对我们来说是一个进行中的工作。

segments.en: And so I'll probably be posing as many questions as having answers.
segments.zh: 所以我可能会提出很多问题，而不是给出答案。

segments.en: So I think we'll be taking this journey together, putting the pieces of the puzzle together, particularly around inflation and interest rates,
segments.zh: 所以我想我们将一起踏上这段旅程，拼凑拼图，特别是围绕通胀和利率。

segments.en: and especially now that we know so much more from Fed Chairman, Warsh.
segments.zh: 尤其是现在，我们从联储主席沃什那里了解到更多信息。

segments.en: His Jackson Hole presentation was quite illuminating, and we'll go through that as well.
segments.zh: 他在杰克逊霍尔的演讲很有启发性，我们也会详细讨论。

segments.en: And I do think one of the reasons economic indicators are transforming here is because we are
segments.zh: 我认为经济指标正在转变的原因之一，是我们正处于技术革命之中。

segments.en: in a technology revolution. And so I think we're going to see numbers that are going to be quite
segments.zh: 因此，我们将会看到一些让市场共识感到意外的数据。

segments.en: surprising to the consensus view out there.
segments.zh: 这些数据可能会让普遍观点感到非常惊讶。

segments.en: The consensus view is that really nothing much is changing.
segments.zh: 而普遍观点认为，实际上没有什么大的变化。
